data.one_liner: Run a local mock HTTP server inside your Flutter app for REST API testing.
data.what_it_does: Configures and runs a local HTTP server directly within your Flutter application to simulate REST API calls. It allows developers to define mock endpoints and behaviors in code, and offers live control via a companion desktop app or an embedded mobile UI overlay.
use_when: You need to simulate a REST backend during development or testing
Backend endpoints are delayed, under construction, or unreliable
You need to switch between success and error response presets at runtime
avoid_when: You prefer external hosted mocking solutions
strengths: Works completely offline without a backend dependency
Live response editing via a desktop app or in-app UI without rebuilding
weaknesses: Unprotected traffic and running a server on-device introduces security issues, making it unsuitable for production
Limited platform support (Android, iOS, and Web)
data.setup_notes: Ensure WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized() is called before starting Mockzilla. Requires minimum Android SDK 24 (Target SDK 36) and iOS 15.0+.
